data.answer: In 2021, patent filings by small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) grew by 27% compared with 2020. SMEs’ share of organisational patent applicants with Australian operations reached a decadal high, increasing by 7 percentage points over 2020 and 2021.[1]

citations.quote: In 2021, SME patent filings grew 27% from 2020

Focusing only on organisational applicants with Australian operations, 68% are small and medium enterprise (SMEs) and 23% are large entities. In 2021, SME filings grew 27% and the SME share of organisational applicants has reached a decadal high, rising 7 percentage points over 2020 and 2021.

claims.text: In 2021, SME patent filings grew by 27% compared with 2020, and their share of organisational patent applicants with Australian operations reached a decadal high after rising 7 percentage points over 2020 and 2021.
